## Flagship Products & Platforms
- CodeXpertAI (https://nexoratechno-code.web.app): A production-grade developer platform developed entirely by Nexora Techno. Synchronizes hands-on Monaco Editor containerized multi-language code execution (CodeLab) with real-time AI-guided technical mock interviews (InterviewAI) and 5-tier unified skill intelligence. Built using React 18, TypeScript, Firebase Suite, and Gemini AI.
- Nexora LMS & Verification Portal: Proprietary student management and credential verification system with tamper-evident QR code validation.
